title: Payment types
description: Turn on the payment types you accept and order them the way you want them shown at checkout. Custom types (Uber Eats, vouchers) only record the sale — Avoqado does not process that money.
empty: No payment types in this section.

form.name: Name
form.countsAsCashHint: Turn on if this payment physically enters the drawer (e.g. vouchers). Uber Eats does not.
form.captureTipHint: The point of sale will ask for a tip when charging with this type.
form.showOnPos: Show on the point of sale
form.showOnPosHint: Turn off if you only use it to reconcile reports.
form.commissionHint: Percentage the platform or issuer keeps (e.g. Uber ~30%). Informational, for your reports.
form.satHint: If a customer requests an invoice for a sale with this type, this SAT form will be used. Without one, individual invoicing is blocked.

commissions.title: What they cost you
commissions.subtitle: Commission you paid per payment type over the last 30 days.
commissions.empty: You haven't charged with any custom payment type yet.
